news.why: Fast-moving product launch. Claim-vs-evidence was used for news in each of the last 3 issues, so three-things (what it does, how it is governed, what analysts doubt) keeps the shape fresh while still letting us attribute every point to Google or to named analysts.

research.why: SafeActBench is numbers-heavy (656 cases, 5 protocols, 10 configurations, 2.0%/1.3% evaluator error rates, static-vs-interactive gap). Label as a preprint, not yet peer-reviewed, with the validators-were-team-members caveat.

invention.why: Single small macOS tool with self-reported results. Run-in labels (What it does / How it works / Why it matters / What's still uncertain) suit an honest-caveat piece. Comparison was used in 2 of the last 3 issues. Explainer used once, in the invention slot only.
